[![問題回報](https://github.com/intergrav/devins-badges/blob/c7fd18efdadd1c3f12ae56b49afd834640d2d797/assets/cozy/documentation/issues_64h.png?raw=true)](https://github.com/Oth3r/MoreHeartTypes/issues)
[![Discord社群](https://github.com/intergrav/devins-badges/blob/v3/assets/cozy/social/discord-singular_64h.png?raw=true)](https://www.oth3r.one/discord)

[![otterlib依賴](https://media.oth3r.one/-a7bWaVAVW5/requires_otterlib.png)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/otterlib)

一款在受到特定類型傷害時添加更多心形材質的模組。可透過設定檔案自訂每種心形的顯示方式！

**執行此模組需安裝 OtterLib，請至[此處下載](https://modrinth.com/mod/otterlib)。**

## 🗃️ 自訂心形設定
使用心形設定檔案來自訂每種心形類型的顯示方式。

![心形設定介面](https://media.oth3r.one/-JUoK99qhTt)
